description: This file defines the interface IPlaybackService for a media playback service within the Rialto server component. It declares virtual methods for controlling playback states, configuring maximum concurrent playbacks and web audio players, retrieving shared memory, and accessing related services like media pipeline and web audio player services.

classes.name: IPlaybackService
classes.description: An interface class for controlling media playback, providing methods to switch activity states, configure limits, and access related services.

methods.name: switchToActive
methods.description: Activates the playback service, making it ready to handle media playback.

methods.name: switchToInactive
methods.description: Deactivates the playback service, stopping media playback handling.

methods.name: setMaxPlaybacks
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of concurrent playback sessions.

methods.name: setMaxWebAudioPlayers
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of concurrent Web Audio players.

methods.name: setClientDisplayName
methods.description: Sets the display name for the client, used for identification.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Returns whether the playback service is currently active.

methods.name: getSharedMemory
methods.description: Retrieves the file descriptor and size of the shared memory buffer used for media data.

methods.name: getMaxPlaybacks
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of allowed concurrent playbacks.

methods.name: getMaxWebAudioPlayers
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of Web Audio players.

methods.name: getShmBuffer
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the shared memory buffer used for media data.

methods.name: getMediaPipelineService
methods.description: Provides access to the media pipeline service.

methods.name: getWebAudioPlayerService
methods.description: Provides access to the Web Audio player service.
